title: Quantum phases in the interacting generalized Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model
summary: We investigate the quantum phases of a half-filled generalized interacting Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model with intracell, nearest-neighbor, and next-nearest-neighbor intercell hoppings, together with an on-site inter-sublattice interaction. In the noninteracting limit, the model hosts one topologically trivial phase and two symmetry-protected topological (SPT) phases, distinguished under periodic boundary conditions by different winding numbers and under open boundary conditions by two-fold and four-fold entanglement-spectrum degeneracies, respectively.
